title: Evidence requests that ask only for the gap
scope: Propose itemised evidence requests from Lekuka/ASYCUDA mismatches and assurance findings so the taxpayer sees what RSL already holds and answers only the unmatched lines (confirm, dispute or attach proof)

acceptance.text: A proposed request lists what is already matched and itemises only unmatched lines with confirm, dispute or attach-proof answers; an officer approves it before it reaches the taxpayer
The request never asks for data RSL holds and never shows risk scores or officer findings
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Tests on TAX-118 synthetic taxpayers: requests contain only unmatched lines; approval is required

evidence.text: vati_tax.evidence_gaps (ADR-050): propose_gap_request builds, from RSL's Online Refunds claim lines and the lane proposal's TAX-112 line_match, a proposal listing already-held lines (Lekuka, ASYCUDA, Online Refunds upload) and one item per unmatched/supplier_gap line with answers confirm, dispute, attach_proof; nothing is stored. approve_gap_request (auditor/supervisor) re-checks the proposal digest and records it through the TAX-046 authorisation, writing line_items/already_held on the request. Frappe-free test on the TAX-118 synthetic taxpayers through the real TAX-112 match: items are exactly the unmatched lines, held lines the rest. Bench (disposable site): nothing reaches the portal before approval; approved request shows lines and answers; changed match needs re-review; taxpayer/service/non-refund-team auditor refused.

Items never cover lines RSL already evidences (held lines are shown, not asked). Taxpayer-facing parts are allowlisted (check_taxpayer_safe, responses.line_details/held_lines): no score, lane, finding, officer or internal status code; tests assert none of these words or IDs appear in the proposal or the portal view, on the TAX-118 population and on the bench.

Fresh disposable site (frappe_dev.py verify): install and two migrations ok; app tests 601 OK; bench 241 tests, failing only reminders/test_reminders_bench (pre-existing on main); evidence_gaps bench 5/5 OK. Frappe-free: evidence_gaps 8 OK, responses 12 OK, backend discovery 601 with only the pre-existing Windows path-separator failure; tests/integration and tests/contracts OK; ruff, ruff format, mypy, validate.py clean. Hosted CI does not start (org spending limit).
